map.nu = - epsilon_lat / epsilon_ax。拉伸时轴向伸长、: nu = - epsilon_lat / epsilon_ax. Under tension the axial direction elongates while the lateral direction thins; Poisson's ratio describes this ratio. Metals ≈ 0.3, rubber ≈ 0.5, cork ≈ 0.
map.各向同性线弹性材料 nu 在 -1 到 0.5 之间；0.5 为不可压缩（如橡胶: For isotropic linear-elastic materials nu ranges from -1 to 0.5; 0.5 is incompressible (e.g. rubber), negative values indicate auxetic materials (rare).
map.普通材料不能（会违反体积正定性）；0.5 是各向同性不可压缩上限。特殊拉胀材料: Ordinary materials cannot (it would violate volumetric positive definiteness); 0.5 is the upper bound for isotropic incompressibility. Special auxetic materials have nu < 0 (lateral expansion under tension).
map.橡胶近似不可压缩，体积几乎不变，轴向拉长必靠横向收缩补偿，故 nu→0.5。: Rubber is nearly incompressible, its volume barely changes, so axial elongation must be compensated by lateral contraction, hence nu → 0.5.
